prompt: Use Collectors.joining with a separator, prefix and suffix to render "[ann, bo]" and an SQL "IN (3, 1, 4)" fragment, including the empty-list cases.
explanation: Collectors.joining(separator, prefix, suffix) glues the prefix and suffix on even when the stream is empty, which is why bracket([]) is "[]" rather than "" -- hand-rolled loops usually get that case wrong. joining only accepts CharSequence elements, so a stream of Integer has to pass through .map(String::valueOf) first. Keeping the delimiter logic inside the collector means there is never a trailing separator to trim off.
hints: Collectors.joining takes one, two, or three arguments; you want the three-argument form.
The prefix and suffix are still emitted for an empty stream -- do not add a special case for it.
A Stream<Integer> cannot be joined directly; map it with String::valueOf to get a Stream<String>.
